void-black.$description: Void Black — Page canvas, primary background — the dominant surface across all dark sections

carbon.$description: Carbon — Elevated surface for nav borders, button outlines, and secondary structural elements against the black canvas

graphite.$description: Graphite — Subtle raised surface for cards or containers sitting on the black canvas — the lightest neutral step before chromatic sections

frost.$description: Frost — Primary text, hairline borders on dark sections, and inverted backgrounds — the most-used color after black

ash.$description: Ash — Muted helper text, icon strokes, and secondary surface fills

smoke.$description: Smoke — Medium-contrast borders, control outlines, and structural separators. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

slate.$description: Slate — Body text borders and the quietest readable gray — used where content recedes into the background

reactor-lime.$description: Reactor Lime — Primary action fill (CTA buttons), announcement bar background, and the sole warm accent — acid yellow-green against black creates instant focal hierarchy

plasma-blue.$description: Plasma Blue — Section background and chromatic border accent — vivid electric violet-blue that shifts the entire page into instrument-mode for feature blocks

abcoracle.$description: Primary UI and body typeface — used for navigation, body copy, labels, buttons, and medium-scale headings. Weight 330 ultra-light is the default; 400 is reserved for body paragraphs and readable text blocks. Positive letter-spacing on sizes ≤16px creates a data-label cadence.

gtpantheon.$description: Display and subheading typeface — weight 330 only, paired with tight negative tracking. Used for section openers and mid-scale titles. The contrast between its lighter cut and abcOracle's 330 creates two distinct text registers without using bold.
